title: Frequently asked
question: Does it call an LLM on every turn?
answer: No. Routing is a deterministic intent table.
The LLM is a fallback for the turns no rule matches —
roughly one in five, all recorded and replayable.
caption: Cheap, fast, and auditable by default.
